name: GPU-Accelerated Image-Aligned Splatting Framework
definition: An object-order rendering approach for scattered data points (ellipsoidal or spherical kernels) using front-to-back compositing, spatial decomposition, and GPU-based early z-culling for occlusion culling and splat elimination.
summary: This GPU-accelerated framework renders scattered data by replacing warped slicing with a direct screen-aligned pass, enabling efficient occlusion culling via early Z-tests.
